mission.description: Sikholelwa ukuba lonke ishishini, nokuba lingakanani okanye likuphi, kufanele lifikelele kubathengi behlabathi. I-MyPadiFood yavela kwiqaphelo elilula: imiqobo yeelwimi kunye nemali akufanele ithintele amandla eshishini lokusebenzela abathengi kwihlabathi jikelele.

business1.quote: Inkqubo yokuguqulela esetyenziswa yi-AI kunye nemali ezininzi ye-MyPadiFood incede ifama yam ukufikelela kubathengi kumazwe amahlanu ahlukeneyo. Ukuthengisa kukhule nge-300% kwiinyanga ezi-2 kuphela!
business1.highlight: Isakhono se-AI: Ukuhlela iimveliso ngobuchule kunye noqikelelo lwemfuno yamaxesha athile onyaka oluphuculwe uvimba wam kwaye lwandisa ukuthengisa.

business2.name: Regina Olumah
business2.quote: Abathengi bathanda ukuba bangaodola ngolwimi lwasekuhlaleni lwabo ngaphandle kokubhalisa. Ii-oda zam zamazwe ngamazwe zaphindaphindeka ngoko nangoko emva kokuseta ivenkile yam.
business2.highlight: Isakhono se-AI: Uhlalutyo lwemeko yefashoni kunye neengcebiso zobukhulu ezizenzekelayo ezinciphise ukubuyiswa nge-40%.

business3.name: Hunsu Mercy
business3.quote: Iindwendwe zamazwe ngamazwe zingabhuka iiflethi zam ngemali yabo kunye nolwimi lwabo ngoku. Ukudityaniswa kwe-WhatsApp kwenza ukuqinisekiswa kube lula!
business3.highlight: Isakhono se-AI: Amaxabiso aguqukayo kunye nokuphuculwa kokufumaneka okunyuse amaxabiso okuhlala nge-65% unyaka wonke.

answers.whatIsMyPadiFoodAnswer: I-MyPadiFood liqonga le-e-commerce lehlabathi elivumela amashishini ukuthengisa iimveliso kunye neenkonzo kubathengi kwihlabathi jikelele. Iqonga lethu elisekelwe kwi-AI liguqulela ivenkile yakho ngokuzenzekelayo kwiilwimi ezininzi, lijongise iintlawulo zeemali ezininzi, kwaye livumele abathengi ukuba ba-odole nge-WhatsApp ngaphandle kokukhuphela ii-app. Sidiliza imiqobo yeelwimi kunye nemali ukuze ukwazi ukugxila ekukhuleni kweshishini lakho kwihlabathi jikelele.
answers.whoCanUseAnswer: I-MyPadiFood ilungele naliphi na ishishini elifuna ukwandisa kwihlabathi jikelele - ukusuka kwiifama ezincinci kunye neendawo zokutya kwiivenkile ezincinci zefashoni, iinkonzo zobulali, kunye nababoneleli bokuthengisa. Nokuba ungusomashishini omnye, umnini weshishini elincinci okanye ishishini elikhulayo, iqonga lethu liyahlengahlengisa kwiimfuno zakho. Ukuba uneemveliso okanye iinkonzo zokuthengisa kwaye ufuna ukufikelela kubathengi bamazwe ngamazwe, i-MyPadiFood yakhiwe wena.
answers.howDifferentAnswer: Ngokungafaniyo namaqonga e-e-commerce emveli, i-MyPadiFood yenzelwe ngokukodwa urhwebo lwehlabathi. Iimpawu zethu ezizodwa ziquka: (1) Ukuguqulela okusekelwe kwi-AI kwiilwimi ezingaphezu kwama-20 ngaphandle kwenzame yesandla, (2) Abathengi banokwenza i-oda ngaphandle kokudala ii-akhawunti okanye ukukhuphela ii-app, (3) Ukudityaniswa kwe-WhatsApp kulawulo oluhambelanayo lwe-oda, (4) Inkxaso yeemali ezininzi enokuguqulwa ngokuzenzekelayo, (5) Ukuqokelelwa kophononongo lwabathengi olusekelwe kwiifowuni, kunye (6) Akukho lwazi lobuchwepheshe olufunekayo ukuqalisa.
answers.freeTrialAnswer: Ewe! Sinikezela ngovavanyo lwasimahla olunobubele lweentsuku ezili-14 ngokufikelela okupheleleyo kuzo zonke iimpawu. Akukho khadi letyala elifunekayo ukuqala uvavanyo lwakho. Oku kukunika ixesha elininzi lokuseta ivenkile yakho, wongeze iimveliso, ulungelelanise izicwangciso zakho, kwaye uvavanye zonke iimpawu zethu. Emva kokuba uvavanyo lweentsuku ezili-14 lugqityiwe, ivenkile yakho iya kunqunyanyiswa okwethutyana de ukhethe isicwangciso somrhumo esikusebenzela. Ungayivuselela nanini na ngokubhalisela.
answers.subscriptionPlansAnswer: Sinikezela ngezicwangciso zomrhumo eziguquguqukayo ukuze zihambelane neemfuno zeshishini lakho: imirhumo yenyanga yokuba nokuguquguquka okukhulu, izicwangciso zekota ezinokonga iindleko, imirhumo yezigidi ezithandathu (iinyanga ezi-6) yexabiso elingcono, kunye nezicwangciso zonyaka zamaxabiso angcono. Iindleko zomrhumo zahluka ngokulawulwa lilizwe lakho ukuqinisekisa amaxabiso alingeneyo asekelwe kwiimeko zoqoqosho lwasekuhlaleni. Qhagamshelana neqela lethu lenkxaso nge-WhatsApp ukufumana amaxabiso athile elizwe lakho kwaye uxoxe ngeyiphi isicwangciso esihambelana kakuhle neenjongo zeshishini lakho.
answers.paymentMethodsAnswer: Samkela iindlela zentlawulo ezininzi zeendleko zomrhumo ngokuxhomekeke kwilizwe lakho, kubandakanya amakhadi etyala/edebit, ukudluliselwa kwemali kwiibhanki, imali yeselula, kunye nezinye iindlela zentlawulo zasekuhlaleni. Injongo yethu kukwenza kube lula kangangoko ukuba ubhalisele kwaye ugcine i-akhawunti yakho. Qhagamshelana neqela lethu lenkxaso ukufunda ngeendlela zentlawulo ezithile ezikhoyo kummandla wakho.
answers.cancelAnytimeAnswer: Ngokuqinisekileyo! Unolawulo olupheleleyo kumrhumo wakho. Ungayirhoxisa nanini na ngaphandle kwezohlwayo okanye iindleko ezifihlakeleyo. Ukuba uyarhoxisa ngexesha lomjikelo wakho we-invoyisi, uya kuqhubeka ufikelela kwivenkile yakho ukuya kuthi ga ekupheleni kwelo xesha lihlawulweyo. Sikholelwa ekuzuzeni ishishini lakho nyanga nganye, hayi ekukuvalela kwizivumelwano zexesha elide ongafuniyo.
answers.languagesSupportedAnswer: I-MyPadiFood okwangoku ixhasa iilwimi eziphambili ezingaphezu kwama-20 kubandakanya isiNgesi, isiSpanish, isiFrentshi, isiJamani, isiTshayina, isi-Arabhu, isiHindi, isiPhuthukezi, isiRashiya, isiJapan, isiKorea, isi-Italiano, isiDatshi, isiTurkey, isiPolish, isiVietnam, isiThai, isi-Indonesia, isiRomania, kunye nesiCzech. Inkqubo yethu yokuguqulela nge-AI iqinisekisa ukuba iinkcazo zeemveliso zakho, imenyu, kunye nomxholo wevenkile ziguqulelwe ngokuchanekileyo kwixesha langempela. Sihlala songeza iilwimi ezingakumbi ngokusekelwe kwimfuno yabathengi.
answers.currenciesSupportedAnswer: Ungamkela iintlawulo phantse nakweyiphi na imali ephambili kwihlabathi jikelele. Iqonga lethu liphatha ukuguqulwa kwemali kwixesha langempela ngokuzenzekelayo, ngoko abathengi babona amaxabiso ngemali yabo yasekuhlaleni ngelixa wamkela iintlawulo ngemali oyithandayo. Oku kubandakanya i-USD, i-EUR, i-GBP, i-NGN, i-JPY, i-CNY, i-INR, kunye nezinye ezininzi. Inkqubo ihlaziya amaxabiso otshintshiselwano rhoqo ukuqinisekisa amaxabiso achanekileyo.
answers.whatsappOrdersAnswer: Xa abathengi benza ii-oda kwivenkile yakho ye-MyPadiFood, ufumana izaziso ngoko nangoko ngqo kwinombolo yakho ye-WhatsApp yeshishini. Iinkcukacha ze-oda zilungiselelwe ngokucacileyo ngolwazi lomthengi, izinto eziodolweyo, idilesi yokuhanjiswa, kunye nemeko yentlawulo. Ungaqinisekisa ii-oda, uhlaziye abathengi ngemeko ye-oda, kwaye unxibelelane ngqo nge-WhatsApp - akukho mfuneko yokufunda inkqubo entsha. Kulula ngokufana nokuba nencoko nomthengi wakho.
answers.customDomainAnswer: Ewe! Ungayidibanisa i-domain yakho yomntu kwivenkile yakho ye-MyPadiFood yamava obugcisa ophawulweyo. Umzekelo, endaweni ye-ishishini-lakho.mypadifood.com, ungasebenzisa ivenkile.ishishini-lakho.com okanye nayiphi na i-domain onayo. Lo msebenzi ufumaneka kwizicwangciso zomrhumo ezikhethiweyo. Iqela lethu lenkxaso linokukukhokela kwinkqubo elula yokuseta.
answers.cashPaymentsAnswer: I-MyPadiFood AYAMKELI, ijonge, okanye ilawule iintlawulo ngemali ngegama leshishini lakho. Zonke iintengiselwano ezinxulumene nemali zilawulwa ngqo phakathi kwakho nabathengi bakho. Ugcina ulawulo olupheleleyo kwiintlawulo zakho ngemali, ukuqokelelwa, kunye nokudibanisa. I-MyPadiFood iqhubela phambili kuphela iqonga lokuodola kunye nokuqhubekeka kweentlawulo zedijithali. Naziphi na izivumelwano zentlawulo ngemali luxanduva lwakho ukulawula ngokuzimeleyo.
answers.setupTimeAnswer: Uninzi lwamashishini lunokuba nevenkile yawo isetwe ngokupheleleyo kwaye ilungele ukwamkela ii-oda kwiiyure ezingama-24 okanye ngaphantsi. Inkqubo yethu yokwamkelwa elungelelanisiweyo ikukhokela ngale ndlela: ukudala i-akhawunti yakho, ukongeza iimveliso zakho, ukuseta iindlela zentlawulo, ukulungelelanisa imbonakalo yevenkile, kunye nokudibanisa i-WhatsApp yakho. Uninzi lwabasebenzisi lugqiba ukuseta kwisiseko kwiiyure ezingaphantsi kwezi-2. Sinika isikhokelo esinyathelo ngesinyathelo kunye nenkxaso ekuncedeni usungule ngokukhawuleza.
answers.technicalKnowledgeAnswer: Akukho lwazi lobuchwepheshe olufunekayo! I-MyPadiFood yenzelwe abanini bamashishini, hayi abaphuhlisi. Ujongano lwethu olucacileyo lukukhokela kuwo onke amanyathelo ngemiyalelo ecacileyo. Akufuneki wazi ukufaka ikhowudi, uqonde ukusingatha iwebhusayithi, okanye ulawule iiseva. Ukuba ungayisebenzisa i-WhatsApp kunye ne-imeyile, ungayilawula ivenkile yakho ye-MyPadiFood. Iqela lethu lenkxaso likwafumaneka ukunceda nayo nayiphi na imibuzo.
answers.productLimitAnswer: Akukho mda kwinani leemveliso onokuzongezelela kwivenkile yakho. Nokuba uneemveliso ezili-10 okanye ezili-10,000, i-MyPadiFood inokuphatha ikhathalogi yakho. Ungahlela iimveliso ngokwezigaba, wongeze iinkcazo ezineenkcukacha kunye nemifanekiso, umisele amanqanaba ovimba, kwaye ulawule yonke into kwi-dashboard yakho. Njengoko ishishini lakho likhula, ivenkile yakho ikhula nawe.
answers.migrationAnswer: Ewe, singakunceda ufudusele ivenkile yakho ye-intanethi ekhoyo kwi-MyPadiFood! Sixhasa ukufuduka kumaqonga ahlukeneyo kubandakanya i-Shopify, i-WooCommerce, kunye nezinye iinkqubo ze-e-commerce. Iqela lethu linokunceda ngokudlulisela ikhathalogi yakho yeemveliso, idatha yabathengi, kunye nembali ye-oda. Qhagamshelana neqela lethu lenkxaso nge-WhatsApp ukuxoxa ngeemfuno zakho ezithile zokufuduka, ixesha, kunye nazo naziphi na iimfuno ezilungiselelweyo. Siya kwenza utshintsho lube lula kangangoko.
answers.customerSupportAnswer: Sinika inkxaso ebanzi ngeendlela ezininzi: inkxaso ye-WhatsApp yemibuzo ekhawulezayo kunye noncedo lwexesha langempela, inkxaso ye-imeyile yemibuzo eneenkcukacha, iziko loncedo ezinezikhokelo kunye nezikhokelo, kunye neevidiyo zokuhamba kuzo iimpawu ezinzima. Iqela lethu lenkxaso lisebenza ngeeyure zeshishini kwaye sineenjongo zokuphendula yonke imibuzo kwiiyure ezingama-24. Iipakethi zenkxaso eziphakamileyo kunye nabaphathi bee-akhawunti abazinikeleyo ziyafumaneka kumashishini akhulayo.
answers.trainingAnswer: Ewe! Sinika izixhobo zoqeqesho ezibanzi ekukuncedeni uphumelele: iseshini yokwamkelwa yasimahla xa ubhalisa, iividiyo zezikhokelo ezigubungela zonke iimpawu, izikhokelo ezibhaliweyo zenyathelo ngesinyathelo, iiwebhina eziphilayo zeempawu ezintsha, kunye neeseshini zoqeqesho lomntu ngomnye (ziyafumaneka ngezicwangciso eziphezulu). Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba uziva ukhuselekile usebenzisa zonke iinkalo zeqonga ukukhulisa ishishini lakho.
answers.updatesAnswer: Siphucula i-MyPadiFood ngokuqhubekayo ngohlaziyo oluqhelekileyo kunye neempawu ezintsha. Ukukhutshwa kweempawu ezinkulu kudla ngokwenzeka ngokwekota, kunye nophuculo oluncinci kunye nokulungiswa kwempazamo okukhutshwa njengoko kufuneka. Zonke izihlaziyo zibandakanywa kumrhumo wakho ngaphandle kweendleko ezongezelelweyo. Sibhengeza iimpawu ezintsha nge-imeyile, izaziso ze-app, kunye namajelo ethu emithombo yendaba yoluntu. Impendulo yakho inceda ukubumba irobhothwe yethu, ngoko sihlala sakha oko amashishini akudingelayo kakhulu.
